text:
maya (infosec): Quick alert — vendor disclosed OpenSSL + glibc patches that affect alpine:3.18 and ubuntu-jammy base images we use for runtimes. Can we triage risk and define a rollout + gating plan? :eyes:
julian (platform): Which CVEs exactly? any RCE vectors or just DoS / infoleak?
maya (infosec): CVE details in the vendor advisory link (redacted here). Scoring looks high for chainable RCE in certain configs, but most workloads low-exposure. We should assume high risk for any public endpoints.
olga (eng-sre): quick inventory: Dedicated pools use ubuntu-jammy:2025-11 snapshots. Hosted API uses alpine:3.18 on many ephemeral workers. Private images vary. I'll dump service mapping and share.
beth (devex): tagging note — we must keep model-serving images signed and recorded in provenance. KMS integration required for promotion into prod.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline notice — new image builds will trigger full integration tests and canary deploys.
maya (infosec): Proposed priority: 1) public-facing hosted API nodes (high exposure), 2) Dedicated GPU pools with public ingress, 3) private on-prem schedule (customer coordination). Agree?
julian (platform): agree. Add RBAC gating: only infra-admin and sec-oncall can approve a prod image promotion until audit log verified. We should add a temporary policy: require label `sec.patched=true` and signed-by KMS key `redwood-sec` for promotion.
olga (eng-sre): For canary sizes suggest 5% of traffic for 2 hours with perf and regression hooks. If OK, ramp to 25% for 1 hour, then full. Rollback trigger: tail latency + error rate + output-diff.
beth (devex): Tests to include: token-level latency harness, kv-cache warmup smoke, model output consistency check (fuzzy match), and memory/leak checks. I can add CI jobs.
maya (infosec): Audit requirements: every promotion must have a signed artifact, an entry in audit log with approver, and a link to the vuln-triage PR. audit-bot should annotate the deploy.
audit-bot: Reminder — existing audit pipeline supports `promotion_record` metadata with keys: `image`, `promoter`, `kms_key_id`, `cve_refs`. Use `gcloud kms asymmetric-sign` or internal HSM via /kms-sign.
julian (platform): KMS steps (short):
```bash
# build and sign
docker build -t gcr.io/redwood/base:alpine-openssl-patched-2026 .
gcloud auth configure-docker gcr.io
docker push gcr.io/redwood/base:alpine-openssl-patched-2026
# sign the digest
DIGEST=$(gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood/base:alpine-openssl-patched-2026 --format='value(image_summary.digest)')
gcloud kms asymmetric-sign --key=redwood-sec --digest=$DIGEST --out=signature.sig
# upload signature to artifact store
upload-signature --image-digest $DIGEST --signature signature.sig --metadata "sec.patched=true,cve=CVE-2026-XXXX"
```
julian (platform): We'll add an automated check in release pipeline to verify signature matches KMS key and label present.
olga (eng-sre): Rebuild matrix: we need alpine:3.18 x86_64, arm64; ubuntu-jammy x86_64, arm64; variant with musl/glibc compat shim. Build jobs parallel. I estimate ~4h per arch for full CI.
maya (infosec): Dependencies: confirm OpenSSL patch is ABI-compatible. If not, we need to bump model runtime images and run JIT tests. Any breaking reports?
beth (devex): I ran local smoke — OpenSSL minor bump didn't break loader for most models, but there was one edge case with legacy tokenizers using a system-ssl. Adding a compatibility test for tokenizer init.
julian (platform): Rollout checklist draft:
- build images (all arch)
- sign with KMS `redwood-sec`
- add `sec.patched=true` tag to artifact metadata
- run CI smoke + model output diff job
- create promo PR with approver tag (sec-oncall, infra-admin)
- audit-bot records promotion
- deploy canary 5% 2h -> 25% 1h -> 100%
- monitor latency, errors, output drift, mem, OOMs
- rollback to previous signed digest if trigger hit

maya (infosec): RBAC change we need: temporary policy to enforce `promotion` approvals. @beth can you open change request to identity team to add policy and short TTL (48h) for this exception?
beth (devex): on it — will tag sec-oncall and infra-admin in the change request.
olga (eng-sre): Also need to coordinate with customer success for Private customers who pinned images. We should prepare communication templates and offer backports.
maya (infosec): Communication template draft: short explanation, CVE links, impact assessment, recommended action, timeline for patched images, and opt-in for managed rollout. I'll draft and share.
julian (platform): For tracking, create a triage ticket per base-image variant with fields: cve_refs, affected services, build status, signature, canary status, risk level. We should link to that ticket from promo PR.
maya (infosec): Action items:
- olga: inventory + build ETA (by EOD)
- julian: add sign-and-verify pipeline steps and RBAC gating (tomorrow)
- beth: CI jobs for model diff + change request to identity (tomorrow)
- maya: draft customer comms and final risk note (EOD)
- sec-oncall: be ready to approve promos and triage alerts during rollout

olga (eng-sre): I'll start builds now and post progress. first artifact expected in ~3h.
maya (infosec): thanks — please @mention sec-oncall when first signed artifact is ready. :thumbsup:
julian (platform): one more: ensure we pin libc/openssl patch versions in SBOM and publish to internal CVE feed.
beth (devex): CI job names I'll add: `smoke/op-compat`, `smoke/model-diff`, `perf/latency-harness`.
audit-bot: Promotion requirement enforced: `signature_verified == true AND metadata.sec.patched == "true" AND approver IN ["infra-admin","sec-oncall"]`.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled once `promotion_record` exists and signature validated.
maya (infosec): Good. We'll reconvene after first canary run. Keep replies brief here to avoid noise.
olga (eng-sre): update: first alpine x86_64 build finished, pushed, signature uploaded. digest: sha256:abcd... I'll post the PR link in 5.
maya (infosec): great — thanks everyone.
julian (platform): :shipit:"
